Here is the Python script to find the real roots of the given equation:

```python
import sympy as sp

# Define the variable
x = sp.symbols('x')

# Define the left-hand side of the equation
lhs = ((x + 1)*(x - 3)/(5*(x + 2)*(x - 4)) + 
        (x + 3)*(x - 5)/(9*(x + 4)*(x - 6)) - 
        (2*(x + 5)*(x - 7)/(13*(x + 6)*(x - 8))) - 
        92/585)

# Solve the equation
roots = sp.solve(lhs, x)

# Filter for real roots
real_roots = [root.evalf() for root in roots if root.is_real]

# Print the real roots
print(real_roots)
```

Please execute this code to find the real roots of the equation.
